CHAPTER.VERS: And if his oblation shall a sacrifice of peace offering, if he shall offer of the herd; whether a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood around upon the altar.

And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that upon the inwards,
fat: or, suet

And the two kidneys, and the fat that on them, which by the flanks, and the fat above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
caul…: or, midriff over the liver, and over the kidneys
And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which upon the wood that on the fire: an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.
And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering to the LORD shall of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
If he shall offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood of it around upon the altar.

And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the whole rump, that shall he take off close to the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that upon the inwards,
And the two kidneys, and the fat that upon them, which by the flanks, and the fat above the liver, with the kidneys, that shall he take away.
And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.
And if his offering shall a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around upon the altar.
And he shall offer of it his offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that upon the inwards,
And the two kidneys, and the fat that upon them, which by the flanks, and the fat above the liver, with the kidneys, that shall he take away.
And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat the LORD’S.
a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
